summary: Frontend-only regression on the profile-edit modal fix in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx. Flow (email signup -> 3-step onboarding -> Profilo tab -> avatar tap -> modal) PASSED all 10 assertions. Signed up tester<ts>@test.dev / Testing123!, completed onboarding (category=Politica, age=28, sex=M, first region), landed on profile-screen. Tapping profile-avatar opened profile-edit-modal with modalSheetTall applied (measured height=776.46px = 92% of 844 viewport). All required children rendered at non-zero heights (bio-input=90px, each of 5 social-input-*=36px, photo-add-library/photo-add-camera=90px, profile-edit-save=57px, profile-edit-close=28x26) confirming the KeyboardAvoidingView flex-collapse bug is fixed. Filling bio='Test bio' + social-input-instagram='@myhandle' and tapping profile-edit-save closed the modal and profile-bio in header shows 'Test bio'. Alt entry via profile-edit-button opens the same modal with bio pre-loaded='Test bio'. profile-edit-close (X) dismisses the modal. No red-screen errors, no React Native runtime warnings related to the modal.
action_items: None for this bug fix — the profile-edit modal now renders with correct height and all form fields are visible/interactable. Regression test coverage is sufficient.
critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx is now ~677 lines — still under the 700-line soft cap but growing; consider extracting ProfileEditModal into its own component in a future refactor.

The fix pattern (modalSheetTall height:'92%' + inner ScrollView style={flex:1} + KeyboardAvoidingView with matching flex:1 + Pressable backdrop with stopPropagation on the sheet) is a solid RN Web + native compatible approach. Same pattern should be applied to the prefs-modal (modalSheet with only maxHeight) to prevent similar regressions if that modal ever gets tall content.

The console emitted one non-blocking warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — likely from a third-party dependency or an internal component; not caused by the fix but worth tracking.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: modalSheet had only maxHeight:'85%' (no explicit height). Inside was a KeyboardAvoidingView with flex:1 and its child ScrollView. When flex parent has an unconstrained (max-)height with no explicit height, RN Web/flex resolves the child's flex:1 to 0, collapsing form fields to zero height — only the modal head (MODIFICA PROFILO + close X) and the sticky SALVA footer remained visible. Fix (verified this iteration): (a) new modalSheetTall style adds height:'92%' + maxHeight:'92%' giving the sheet a resolved height; (b) ScrollView gets style={flex:1} so it fills available space between head and SALVA footer; (c) keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled' so taps inside inputs don't dismiss keyboard prematurely; (d) backdrop wrapped in Pressable + sheet uses onPress={e=>e.stopPropagation()} so tapping outside closes the modal but taps inside are preserved. All measurements from this run confirm the fix (modal 776px, all inner children non-zero heights).
